subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: The boy said to the teacher, "Sir, I shall be much obliged if you kindly lend me the book you praised highly in the class yesterday." The teacher said, "I am very glad to know that you are eager to read this book. You can take any of my books you like." Thank you, Sir."
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech The boy told the teacher respectfully that he (B) would be much obliged if he (T) kindly lent him (B) the book he (T) had prised highly in the classroom the previous day. The teacher said that he was very glad to know that he (B) was eager to read that book. He added that he (B) could take any of his books he (B) liked. The boy then thanked the teacher respectfully.
